# Logging & Observability Requirements Checklist: Application Logging and Observability

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the logging and
observability requirements before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the required fields of a request-completion log entry (method, path, status, duration) fully enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the supported severity levels explicitly listed rather than referenced generically? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for logging at application lifecycle events (startup, listening) in addition to per-request events? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the behavior specified for requests that fail before a response is produced (e.g., malformed input, early middleware rejection)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for where non-request (background/startup) logs obtain a correlation context, if any? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "structured" log output quantified with the concrete required fields (timestamp, level, message) rather than left abstract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "personal family-member content" defined precisely enough to distinguish loggable identifiers/counts from prohibited content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "sensible default" log level specified as a concrete value per environment? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the meaning of "machine-parseable" expressed as a verifiable property (one record per entry, consistent schema)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do the correlation-id requirements align between generating a new id and reusing an inbound id without conflict? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the error-logging requirements consistent with the backend error-handling feature's "no re-raise after response" behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the data-protection requirements (FR-006/FR-007) consistent with the constitution's data-protection constraint? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can "0 secrets appear in logs" be objectively verified against a defined set of secret categories (auth headers, cookies, tokens, session ids)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "logs are filterable by level" expressed as an objectively testable outcome? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK015 Are success criteria stated so that "all entries for one request share a correlation id" is verifiable without implementation detail? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-003]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for a logging-mechanism failure so it cannot crash the app or block a request? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for high request volume so logging does not become blocking or unbounded? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the treatment of high-frequency low-value requests (health checks, static assets) specified so they are neither noisy nor silently dropped? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Is behavior specified when an inbound correlation id is absent, empty, or malformed? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK020 Are performance expectations for logging overhead stated or bounded? [Non-Functional, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the log output destination (standard stream vs files) specified as a requirement rather than an implementation choice? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-009]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK022 Is the dependency/coordination with the backend error-handling feature (009) documented as an assumption? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the exclusion of external log aggregation, metrics, tracing, and alerting explicitly recorded as out of scope? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the assumption about development-vs-production format differences validated against the configurability requirement? [Assumption, Spec §FR-008]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK025 Is there any conflict between "never log response bodies" and any requirement to log actionable error detail? [Conflict, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the documentation requirement (how to set level, where logs go) specific enough to be verified against actual behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Focus areas: data-protection (secret/PII redaction), observability completeness, and configurability
- Depth: Standard | Audience: Reviewer (PR)
